Brampton Plan Schedule 7 Greenway Boulevards are major streets redesigned to function as green, multi‑modal corridors that prioritize walking, cycling, and public space—rather than primarily moving vehicle traffic.Intended for the transformation of traditional car-oriented arterial roads, reimagined as people-oriented corridors.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
